scope: Public literature review; no clinical intervention, samples, or HIV sequences

studies.title: RIO phase II randomized trial of 3BNC117-LS and 10-1074-LS
studies.outcome: 75% no rebound at week 20 versus 11% placebo; 7 participants in treated group with control beyond week 96
studies.limitation: Selected participants mostly early-treated men; delayed rebound/control is not proof of viral elimination

studies.title: Therapeutic vaccine, TLR9 agonist and broadly neutralizing antibodies
studies.outcome: Seven participants with partial or complete post-intervention control
studies.limitation: Small uncontrolled study; proof of concept, not sterilizing cure

studies.title: Improved four-target intact reservoir measurement
studies.outcome: Intact reservoir quantified in 95% of samples across four cohorts; closer concordance to sequence-confirmed genomes
studies.limitation: Currently validated for subtype B; detection from limited samples is not proof of whole-body absence

studies.title: Kansas City and Essen patients: sustained remission following stem cell transplantation
studies.outcome: Sustained antiretroviral-free remission in special cancer-transplant settings
studies.limitation: High-risk cancer-related transplantation is not an option for routine HIV treatment; remission is not universal eradication

studies.title: Designer-recombinase investigational gene-modified stem-cell product
studies.outcome: Manufacturing validated; first-in-human trial in preparation
studies.limitation: No demonstrated patient HIV cure; tissue delivery, completeness, durability and safety unresolved

studies.title: ACTG A5413 dasatinib reservoir study
studies.outcome: Trial initiated to assess safety and reservoir impact; no result established
studies.limitation: No trial efficacy outcome yet; dasatinib is not an approved HIV cure
